Have Llama3-70B-Instruct, Qwen2-72B-Instruct, Yi-1.5-34B-Chat, and Mixtral-8x22B-Instruct answer without images ten times each

Remove 70 invalid items to obtain 1,730 standard questions with up to ten choices
Manually capture each item as a photo or screenshot under varied display conditions, producing 1,730 standard and 1,730 vision-only representations

删除 70 道无效题，得到最多十选项的 1,730 道标准题
在多样显示条件下把每题人工拍成照片或截图，形成 1,730 个标准表示与 1,730 个纯视觉表示

Run Direct and chain-of-thought prompts and retain the higher result for reporting
Compute overall MMMU-Pro accuracy as the average of standard and vision-only scores
Analyze OCR with normalized Levenshtein similarity and study chain-of-thought and error effects

以标准和纯视觉得分均值计算 MMMU-Pro 总体准确率
用归一化 Levenshtein 相似度分析 OCR，并研究思维链和错误影响

construction_steps_zh: 汇集 MMBench、SEED、MMMU、ScienceQA、AI2D 和 MathVista 的 22,401 个样本

evidence_summary_en: The primary TACL paper specifies anonymized aggregated Google queries of at least eight words, question-form filtering, retaining queries whose top five results contain Wikipedia, a three-stage annotation protocol for question validity, earliest smallest long answer, and short/yes-no/null answer, 307,373 single-annotated Train examples plus 7,830/7,842 five-way Dev/Test sets, beta=2 consensus handling, and separate long- and short-answer precision, recall, and F1.
evidence_summary_zh: Natural Questions 的 TACL 原始论文明确说明采集至少八词的匿名聚合 Google 查询，经问句形式筛选并仅保留前五个结果含 Wikipedia 的查询，采用问题有效性、最早最小长答案、短答案/是非/空答案三阶段标注，发布 307,373 个单标训练样本及 7,830/7,842 个五人标开发/测试样本，以 beta=2 处理一致性，并分别报告长答案和短答案的精确率、召回率与 F1。
construction_steps_en: Sample anonymized aggregated Google queries of at least eight words that multiple users issued in a short period
Apply question-form heuristics and exclude non-questions and how-to queries
Run Google Search and retain a query-page pair only when Wikipedia appears in the top five results
Have an annotator judge whether the query is a good fact question before seeing the page
Select the earliest smallest paragraph, table, or list containing the long answer, or mark NULL
Mark short entity span or spans, yes/no, or no short answer within the long answer
Release 307,373 single-annotated Train examples and five-way Dev/Test sets of 7,830 and 7,842
construction_steps_zh: 抽取多位用户在短时间内提交、至少八词的匿名聚合 Google 查询
应用问句形式启发式规则，并排除非问题和 how-to 查询
执行 Google 搜索，仅当 Wikipedia 位于前五个结果时保留查询-页面对
由标注员在看到页面前判断查询是否为有效事实问题
选择包含长答案的最早最小段落、表格或列表，否则标记为空
在长答案内标注短实体跨度、是/否，或无短答案
发布 307,373 个单标训练样本及 7,830 和 7,842 个五人标开发/测试样本
evaluation_steps_en: With beta=2, require a non-null prediction when at least two of five references are non-null; otherwise predict NULL
Match a non-null prediction against any annotated answer
Report precision, recall, and F1 separately for long and short answers
evaluation_steps_zh: 在 beta=2 下，五个参考中至少两个非空时必须预测非空答案，否则预测空答案
非空预测与任一标注答案匹配
分别报告长答案与短答案的精确率、召回率和 F1

evidence_summary_en: The TriviaQA paper specifies collecting questions and answers from 14 trivia and quiz-league sites, removing questions shorter than four tokens, independent Web evidence retrieval through Bing and Wikipedia evidence retrieval through TAGME, answer-string distant-supervision filtering, 95,956 QA pairs with 662,659 evidence documents, 80/10/10 QA splitting, human-verified Dev/Test subsets, and SQuAD-style EM/F1 with aliases and domain-specific aggregation.
evidence_summary_zh: TriviaQA 论文明确说明从 14 个知识问答和 quiz league 网站收集问答并删除少于四个词元的问题，通过 Bing 独立构建 Web 证据、通过 TAGME 构建 Wikipedia 证据，以答案字符串做远程监督过滤，形成 95,956 个问答对和 662,659 份证据文档，按问答对做 80/10/10 划分，发布人工验证的开发/测试子集，并使用支持别名及分域聚合的 SQuAD 风格 EM/F1。
construction_steps_en: Collect QA pairs from 14 trivia and quiz-league sites and remove questions shorter than four tokens
For Web evidence, query Bing with the question but not the answer, inspect the top 50 URLs, and crawl the top ten after filtering trivia and bad documents
For Wikipedia evidence, use TAGME to link question entities and add their corresponding pages
For distant supervision, keep only evidence documents containing a correct answer string
Release 95,956 QA pairs with 662,659 evidence documents, including about 650K Web and 78K Wikipedia examples
Randomly split QA pairs 80/10/10 and have humans mark answerable Dev/Test subsets
construction_steps_zh: 从 14 个知识问答和 quiz league 网站收集问答对，并删除少于四个词元的问题
构建 Web 证据时只用问题查询 Bing，检查前 50 个 URL，过滤知识问答站和坏文档后抓取前十页
构建 Wikipedia 证据时用 TAGME 链接问题实体并加入对应页面
做远程监督时仅保留含正确答案字符串的证据文档
发布 95,956 个问答对和 662,659 份证据文档，包括约 650K 个 Web 与 78K 个 Wikipedia 样本
按问答对随机划分 80/10/10，并由人工标出可回答的开发/测试子集
evaluation_steps_en: Predict an answer from the supplied evidence with a reading-comprehension model
Compute exact match and token F1 while accepting Wikipedia aliases
Aggregate at question level for Wikipedia and document level for Web, reporting full and verified subsets
evaluation_steps_zh: 阅读给定证据并预测答案
在接受 Wikipedia 别名的前提下计算精确匹配和词元 F1
Wikipedia 按问题级、Web 按文档级聚合，并分别报告完整集与人工验证子集

evidence_summary_en: The CommonsenseQA paper specifies filtering ConceptNet to 236,208 triplets, grouping same-source same-relation targets into about 43K question sets, AMT formulation with a 75% worker-quality gate, adding one same-relation and one worker-written distractor for five choices, disjoint two-worker verification that removes 15%, optional 500-snippet Web context, 16,242 formulated and 12,247 final questions, primary random 80/10/10 splitting, and accuracy evaluation.
evidence_summary_zh: CommonsenseQA 论文明确说明把 ConceptNet 过滤为 236,208 个三元组，将同源同关系的目标分组为约 43K 个候选问题集，由 AMT 标注员出题并设置 75% 质量门，加入一个同关系干扰项和一个人工合理干扰项形成五选一题，由互斥的两位验证者复核并过滤 15%，可选提供 500 条网页片段上下文，从 16,242 道初始题得到 12,247 道最终题，以随机 80/10/10 为主划分并用准确率评测。
construction_steps_en: Filter generic or weak ConceptNet edges and retain 236,208 triplets
Group three targets sharing the same source concept and relation into about 43K candidate question sets
Have AMT workers write three discriminative questions per set while avoiding obvious surface clues
Retain question writers only when at least 75% of their questions pass verification
Add one same-relation ConceptNet distractor and one worker-written plausible distractor to form five choices
Use two disjoint verification workers and keep an item if at least one answers correctly, filtering 15%
Optionally retrieve 100 snippets for the question plus each candidate, for 500 snippets per question
Reduce 16,242 formulated questions to 12,247 final items and use the primary random 80/10/10 split
construction_steps_zh: 过滤 ConceptNet 中过于通用或关系较弱的边，保留 236,208 个三元组
把共享源概念和关系的三个目标分成约 43K 个候选问题集
由 AMT 标注员每组编写三道区分性问题，并避免明显表面线索
仅保留至少 75% 问题通过验证的出题标注员
加入一个同关系 ConceptNet 干扰项和一个人工合理干扰项，形成五个选项
由两位互斥验证标注员复核，至少一人答对才保留，共过滤 15%
可选地为问题加每个候选项检索 100 条片段，每题共 500 条
把 16,242 道初始题筛为 12,247 道最终题，并使用主要的随机 80/10/10 划分
evaluation_steps_en: Choose one answer from five candidates
Report test accuracy and compare with the human majority-vote baseline
evaluation_steps_zh: 从五个候选项中选择一个答案
报告测试准确率，并与人类多数票基线比较

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies seven passage domains, CoreNLP selection of multi-entity passages, passage-level in-domain and out-of-domain splits, a worker qualification test, paired real-time questioner/answerer collection, paraphrase alerts, rationale-first free-form answers, three additional Dev/Test answers, 8,399 conversations with 127K turns, and normalized macro word-overlap F1 averaged over four references.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出七类段落来源、用 CoreNLP 筛选多实体段落、按段落设置域内与域外划分、标注员资格测试、提问者与回答者实时配对采集、改写提示、先标依据再编辑自由答案、开发/测试每题三份附加答案、8,399 段对话和 127K 轮，以及对四个参考答案平均的归一化词重合宏 F1。
construction_steps_en: Select multi-entity passages of about 200 words from seven domains using CoreNLP
Reserve 100 Dev and 100 Test passages per in-domain source and 100 Test passages each for Reddit and Science
Qualify AMT workers and pair a questioner with an answerer through ParlAI
Prompt questioners to avoid exact passage wording and ask context-dependent follow-ups
Have answerers highlight a rationale span and edit the copied text into a natural free-form answer
Release 8,399 conversations with 127K turns and collect three additional answers for every Dev/Test question
construction_steps_zh: 用 CoreNLP 从七个领域筛选约 200 词的多实体段落
每个域内来源保留 100 个开发和 100 个测试段落，Reddit 与科学各保留 100 个域外测试段落
通过 AMT 资格测试后，用 ParlAI 配对提问者和回答者
提示提问者避免照抄原文，并提出依赖对话上下文的追问
回答者先高亮依据跨度，再把复制文本编辑成自然自由答案
发布 8,399 段对话和 127K 轮，并为每道开发/测试题再收集三个答案
evaluation_steps_en: Predict the next free-form answer from the passage and gold-answer conversation history
Remove articles and punctuation before computing word-overlap F1
Average each prediction's F1 across the original and three additional references, then macro-average questions
evaluation_steps_zh: 根据段落和金标答案对话历史预测下一轮自由答案
移除冠词与标点后计算词重合 F1
每个预测对原答案和三个附加答案的 F1 取平均，再对问题做宏平均

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies rewriting ATOMIC's 24K events, template questions from nine inference dimensions, two correct answers, parallel handwritten and question-switched negative-answer collection, selecting one correct plus two least-entailed negatives, three-worker Train validation, a second five-worker Dev/Test validation and stylistic filtering, context-disjoint 33,410/1,954/2,224 splits, and three-choice accuracy.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出改写 ATOMIC 的 24K 个事件、基于九类推理维度生成问题模板、编写两个正确答案、并行收集人工负例和问题切换负例、选择一个正确答案与两个蕴含度最低负例、训练集三人验证、开发/测试再由五人验证并做文体过滤、按情境互斥的 33,410/1,954/2,224 划分，以及三选一准确率。
construction_steps_en: Rewrite ATOMIC events by adding names, filling placeholders, and repairing grammar
Expand each event into a social context, edit an inference-template question, and write two correct answers
Collect two handwritten subtly wrong answers and two correct answers to a switched related question
Form a three-choice tuple from one random correct answer and the two least-entailed negatives
Validate Train tuples with three workers and Dev/Test tuples again with five workers, retaining majority labels
Use a deep stylistic classifier to remove easier Dev/Test items and preserve context-disjoint splits
Release 33,410 Train, 1,954 Dev, and 2,224 Test questions
construction_steps_zh: 为 ATOMIC 事件添加姓名、填占位符并修复语法
把事件扩写为社会情境，编辑推理模板问题并编写两个正确答案
收集两个细微错误的人工负例，以及针对相关切换问题的两个正确答案
用一个随机正确答案和两个蕴含度最低的负例组成三选一题
训练题由三人验证，开发/测试题再由五人验证，并保留多数标签
用深层文体分类器移除较容易的开发/测试题，并保持情境互斥
evaluation_steps_en: Read the social context and inference question and score three candidate answers
Choose the highest-probability answer and report accuracy
Compare against humans on 900 sampled Dev and 900 sampled Test items
evaluation_steps_zh: 读取社会情境与推理问题，并对三个候选答案评分
选择最高概率答案并报告准确率
在人类抽样的 900 道开发题和 900 道测试题上做对比

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies an October 2017 English Wikipedia first-paragraph hyperlink graph, manually curated bridge pages, bridge sampling with probability 0.75, comparison sampling from 42 entity lists with half yes/no questions, crowd-written answers and supporting facts, 112,779 examples, Turker and three-fold-model hardness partitioning, separate distractor and full-wiki test sets, and answer/support/joint EM and F1.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出基于 2017 年 10 月英文 Wikipedia 首段的超链接图、人工筛选桥接页面、以 0.75 概率采样桥接题、从 42 组实体列表采样比较题且其中一半为是非题、众包答案与支持事实、112,779 个样本、标注员及三折模型辅助难度划分、独立的干扰段落和全 Wikipedia 测试集，以及答案/支持事实/联合 EM 与 F1。
construction_steps_en: Build a directed graph from links in the first paragraphs of the October 1, 2017 English Wikipedia dump
For bridge questions, sample links whose destination belongs to manually curated suitable pages
For comparison questions, sample two entities from one of 42 lists and use yes/no or span answers
Have crowdworkers write a multi-hop question, answer, and sentence-level supporting facts
Collect 112,779 valid examples and audit top Turkers to isolate 18,089 mostly single-hop train-easy items
Use three-fold model confidence to separate 56,814 train-medium items and split the remaining hard examples
Create a distractor setting with two gold plus eight TF-IDF paragraphs and a separate full-wiki setting
construction_steps_zh: 从 2017 年 10 月 1 日英文 Wikipedia 快照的文章首段链接构建有向图
桥接题采样目标属于人工筛选页面集合的链接
比较题从 42 组列表之一采样两个实体，并使用是非或跨度答案
由众包标注员编写多跳问题、答案和句级支持事实
收集 112,779 个有效样本，并审计高产标注员以分出 18,089 个主要单跳的简单训练样本
用三折模型置信度分出 56,814 个中等训练样本，再划分剩余难题
构建两个金标加八个 TF-IDF 段落的干扰设置，以及独立的全 Wikipedia 设置
evaluation_steps_en: Predict an answer span or yes/no label and a set of supporting sentences
Report answer EM/F1 and supporting-fact EM/F1
Multiply answer and support precision and recall for joint F1; joint EM is one only when both exactly match
evaluation_steps_zh: 预测答案跨度或是非标签，以及支持句集合
报告答案 EM/F1 和支持事实 EM/F1
把答案与支持事实的精确率和召回率分别相乘得到联合 F1；仅两项都精确匹配时联合 EM 为一

evidence_summary_en: The paper specifies question-title PubMed articles with structured conclusions, title/context/long-answer extraction, two M.D.-candidate annotators and consensus for 1,000 PQA-L items, 500-item cross-validation and test halves, a rule-filtered 61.2K PQA-U set, negation-labeled statement-title conversion for 211.3K PQA-A items, optional multi-phase training, and reasoning-required PQA-L accuracy and macro-F1.
evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出含问题标题和结构化结论的 PubMed 文章，抽取标题问题、去结论上下文和结论长答案，由两位医学博士候选人标注并协商 1,000 个 PQA-L 样本，将其各 500 个用于交叉验证和测试，以规则筛得 61.2K 个 PQA-U 样本，按否定状态把陈述标题转为 211.3K 个 PQA-A 样本，可选分阶段训练，并在需推理的 PQA-L 上报告准确率与宏 F1。
construction_steps_en: Collect PubMed articles whose title contains a question mark and whose structured abstract has a conclusion
Use the title as question, the abstract without conclusion as context, and the conclusion as long answer
Have two M.D. candidates label yes/no/maybe with and without the long answer, discussing disagreements or removing items
Build PQA-L with 1,000 items, using 500 for 10-fold cross-validation and 500 for held-out testing
Rule-filter answerable non-wh and non-multi-entity questions to form 61.2K unlabeled PQA-U items
Convert suitable statement titles into questions and label by verb negation to form 211.3K PQA-A items
construction_steps_zh: 收集标题含问号且结构化摘要具有结论部分的 PubMed 文章
以标题为问题、去掉结论的摘要为上下文、结论为长答案
由两位医学博士候选人分别在可见和不可见长答案时标注是/否/不确定，分歧则讨论或移除
构建 1,000 个 PQA-L 样本，其中 500 个用于十折交叉验证，500 个留作测试
用规则筛选可答的非疑问词、非多实体选择问题，形成 61.2K 个未标注 PQA-U 样本
把合适陈述标题转为问题并按动词否定状态标注，形成 211.3K 个 PQA-A 样本
evaluation_steps_en: Optionally pretrain on PQA-A, pseudo-label PQA-U, and fine-tune on PQA-L
At PQA-L inference, provide question plus conclusion-free context and predict yes, no, or maybe
Report held-out test accuracy and macro-F1 across the three labels
evaluation_steps_zh: 可选在 PQA-A 上预训练、为 PQA-U 伪标注，再在 PQA-L 上微调
PQA-L 推理时提供问题与去掉结论的上下文，预测是、否或不确定
在留出测试集上报告准确率和三标签宏 F1

evidence_summary_zh: 论文明确给出收集 USMLE、MCMLE 与 TWMLE 真题和模拟题，去重，为 USMLE/MCMLE 打乱答案并删除一个错误选项，按题目做 80/10/10 划分，英文/简中/繁中分别为 12,723/34,251/14,123 题，把 18 本英文和 33 本简体中文教材经 OCR 构建语料，做专家覆盖率审计，以检索器加阅读器评测并按语言报告准确率。
construction_steps_en: Collect real and mock medical-board questions from US and mainland-China websites and Taiwan official PDFs
Remove duplicate problems, shuffle answer order, and delete one wrong option from USMLE and MCMLE items
Randomly split questions 80/10/10 into exact Train, Dev, and Test sets for all three sources
Prepare 18 English textbooks for USMLE/TWMLE and 33 simplified-Chinese textbooks for MCMLE
OCR the PDF books, correct misspellings, and divide the text into 231,581 English and 116,216 Chinese paragraphs
Have two M.D.s audit evidence coverage on 100 Dev questions per source
construction_steps_zh: 从美国和中国大陆题库网站及中国台湾官方 PDF 收集医学执业真题与模拟题
删除重复题、打乱答案顺序，并从 USMLE 与 MCMLE 每题删除一个错误选项
按题目随机做 80/10/10 划分，得到三来源精确训练、开发和测试集
为 USMLE/TWMLE 准备 18 本英文教材，为 MCMLE 准备 33 本简体中文教材
对 PDF 教材做 OCR、修正拼写并切成 231,581 个英文和 116,216 个中文段落
由两位医学博士对每个来源的 100 道开发题审计证据覆盖率
evaluation_steps_en: Retrieve relevant textbook paragraphs for each question and its answer options
Read the retrieved evidence and choose one correct option among four
Report Dev and Test accuracy separately for English, simplified Chinese, and traditional Chinese
evaluation_steps_zh: 针对问题及答案选项检索相关教材段落
阅读检索证据，并从四个选项中选择唯一正确项
分别报告英文、简体中文和繁体中文的开发与测试准确率

evidence_summary_en: CodeElo selects 387 problems from 54 rated Codeforces contests held from May 4 through November 4, 2024, excluding Div. 1-only contests. It parses descriptions, I/O, examples, and notes while presenting original HTML, and attaches divisions, problem ratings, and hidden algorithm tags. evidence_summary_en: ArtifactsBench aggregates candidates from expert showcases, open SVG/web snippets, case studies, and screenshot-to-query generation. Automated filters remove incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, and non-interactive items; MinHash plus semantic DOM/CSS/JS comparison and screenshot perceptual hashing provide two-stage deduplication. Experts and LLMs repair prompts, performance from more than 30 models calibrates a 30/40/30 difficulty split, and a ten-dimension checklist is drafted by Hunyuan-Turbos and human-refined to Cohen's kappa of at least 0.8. The 1,825 tasks span nine domains. Playwright and Chromium render each artifact deterministically at 1024 by 768 and capture before/during/after screenshots. Qwen2.5-VL-72B and Gemini-2.5-Pro serve as referees, followed by a double-blind 280-instance human study and WebDev Arena rank alignment.

evidence_summary_en: BigO(Bench) begins with 8,139 Code Contests problems and 1,485,888 Python solutions that pass public and private tests. Llama 3.1 405B generates problem-specific input dataclasses, with multi-pass back-translation reaching 82% problem coverage; problems require a working dataclass and at least 50 solutions. Independent, joint, random, and identity expansion generate larger inputs. Bubblewrap isolation, cProfile, and tracemalloc collect runtime and memory measurements. Non-negative least-squares fitting chooses time and space complexity classes using residual minimization plus a simplicity bias and records coefficients. The released corpus has 3,105 problems and 1,190,250 solutions. Human comparison matches 92% for time and 84% for space; separate time and space tests support complexity prediction, constrained generation, and coefficient-percentile ranking with Pass@k, Best@k, and All@k.

evidence_summary_en: BIRD collects 80 open databases from Kaggle, Relation.vit, and open tables, then curates 15 additional databases reserved for hidden testing. Specialists standardize schemas and write table, column, and value descriptions. Experts train and examine crowdworkers, retaining eleven native question writers plus SQL specialists. Questions are written from database descriptions and record external-knowledge evidence. Two SQL annotators independently write and execute queries; result mismatches go to expert resolution. Experts verify executability, non-null results, text-knowledge-SQL alignment, semantic equivalence, and efficiency. The final 12,751 pairs cover 95 databases totaling 33.4 GB and 37 domains, split across 69 train, 11 development, and 15 hidden-test databases. Models receive question, database, and evidence, then executable SQL is scored by Execution Accuracy and Valid Efficiency Score.

evidence_summary_en: CF-Div2-Stepfun selects 53 official Codeforces Division 2 problems from contests held between September 2024 and February 2025 and replaces live online submission with an offline local grader. evidence_summary_en: CodeSimpleQA evaluates factual programming knowledge rather than executable-code correctness. The consistent abstract, Table 1, contributions, conclusion, and limitations report 1,498 items: 782 English and 716 Chinese questions across more than 15 programming languages and 21 domains; one isolated paragraph instead says 1,478/762 and is treated as a textual inconsistency. The benchmark reports three source families: Code WebQA, self-constructed questions, and human-written documentation QA. For the explicitly documented human-written branch, eight annotators turn 1,500 candidates from Stack Overflow, GitHub and official/community documentation into 680 QA pairs; independent engineer review retains 312 with at least three-reviewer consensus. The paper disagrees on total engineer headcount, so the diagram records the consensus rule without inventing that total. The 66.9M-example CodeSimpleQA-Instruct corpus is a separate training asset. Evaluation grades Correct, Not Attempted, or Incorrect and reports Correct, Correct Given Attempted, and F-score.

evidence_summary_en: ComputeEval has no standalone paper located in its official citation; the previous catalog arXiv link is the unrelated OptiML method paper, which only cites ComputeEval. NVIDIA's official 2026.1 release has 566 problems across seven groups: 518 CUDA C++ and 48 CUDA Python, with performance workloads for 499 problems. NVIDIA engineers author the tasks, sometimes with frontier-model assistance, and human engineers review every problem and label. Each contract contains a prompt, visible context, build/test commands, held-out tests, a reference solution, and optional performance workload. CI compiles and runs known-good solutions and validates specifications. Models see no tests or references; isolated evaluation compiles candidates, checks required APIs and held-out tests, and profiles only correct solutions for latency, throughput, and baseline speedup alongside pass@k.

evidence_summary_en: CRUXEval prompts Code Llama 34B with 69 Python standard-library functions (47 str, 11 dict, 11 list) and two varying few-shot examples to generate a function plus five inputs, then executes them for outputs. evidence_summary_en: NYU CTF Bench begins with a 568-challenge CSAW archive spanning 2011-2023; the validated 200-challenge table covers 2017-2023 and six categories. Every retained challenge is manually checked for setup and solvability after dependency changes. Server tasks must connect internally and externally within the Docker network; file tasks must have complete configuration and source artifacts. Docker Hub images, Compose files, source, and JSON metadata are standardized. Models see descriptions, listed files, and host information while the exact flag remains hidden. evidence_summary_en: RepoQA selects 50 repositories, ten each in Python, C++, Java, TypeScript, and Rust, requiring topic diversity, unit tests or CI/CD, and at least 100 stars. Main-package source files are dependency ordered, concatenated, and split into 64 equal chunks. The first uniquely named function with a body under 2,000 bytes in each eligible chunk forms the candidate pool; ten needles are sampled per repository. GPT-4-Turbo writes purpose/input/output/procedure descriptions without function or variable names. Ten needles are placed at 10%-100% depths in a 16k context. Tree-sitter extracts the first valid code block, and retrieval succeeds only if the target has the highest smoothed BLEU among all context functions and exceeds 0.8.

evidence_summary_en: SciCode turns scientists' internal research scripts from 16 natural-science subfields into 80 main problems and 338 ordered subproblems with explicit input-output docstrings. The development split has 15 main and 50 subproblems; the test split has 65 main and 288 subproblems. Scientist gold solutions use common documented NumPy, SciPy, or SymPy functionality. Numerical tests and domain-specific workflows reproduce published results or analytical theory. Three validation rounds combine at least two in-domain scientists, one out-of-domain scientist, and GPT-4 generation followed by scientist failure analysis and test redesign. The standard setting omits background and carries generated prior solutions forward; a main problem passes only when all subproblems and the integrated main solution pass.

evidence_summary_en: Spider 2.0 draws from 213 enterprise databases and a candidate pool of 1,021 complex SQL queries plus 157 DBT projects. evidence_summary_en: TACO directly crawls CodeChef, CodeForces, HackerRank, and GeeksforGeeks, then integrates APPS, CodeContest, and Description2code. Newly crawled solutions are executed; Python 2 code is converted with 2to3 and failures are removed. MinHash with a 0.85 Jaccard threshold deduplicates AST-normalized code, reducing 2,045,502 examples to 1,539,152 verified Python 3 solutions. GPT-4 proposes test inputs, 30 verified solutions establish consensus outputs, and augmentation repeats until at least 200 tests. The detailed paper contribution/table and official repository specify 25,443 training plus 1,000 test problems, despite an isolated 25,433 abstract typo. The release consolidates 968 labels into 36 algorithms and eight skills. Evaluation samples 200 attempts, uses top_p 0.95 and difficulty temperatures 0.2/0.6/0.8, and reports Pass@1/10/100.
